name: TokenRouter.com
notes: Prepaid-balance reseller run by Artemis Tokenrouter Inc.: the account is topped up in advance and each request is charged per token. Prices are the discounted prices TokenRouter.com charged on 2026-11-26 (USD per million tokens, default group); the discounts are promotional and change. Terms risk: the TokenRouter.com Terms of Use forbid in §9.1 "reselling API access, or developing and operating a directly competing aggregation or routing service based on the Services". The same terms (§4.2) give API keys a maximum validity of 30 days: after that the key answers 401, which disables the Provider Account, and the operator must paste a new key. No exhaustedErrorCodes: the status and code for an empty balance are undocumented, and a used-up balance stays a Cooldown, since topping up ends it at any time. TokenRouter.com serves each model on some of its wire formats only, so the Provider has three chat endpoints (chat completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages) and each Upstream Model lists the Protocols TokenRouter.com tags it with in its pricing list (ADR 0095): Claude models list Anthropic Messages first, and the others list chat completions first when they speak it. The key goes in as a bearer token on every endpoint: the New API gateway behind TokenRouter.com accepts Authorization: Bearer on /v1/messages as well as on its OpenAI endpoints. Not shipped: models served only on the native Gemini format, image, video, audio and embedding models, and the system-one decision models. Also not shipped: stealth/union-alpha, since no source gives it a release date; google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, an image-generation model; and anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5-clould and qwen/qwen-3.8-flash-next-qoder, which the pricing list does not tag as Text.
